aggregate_brief: Today's standouts: Coal — 7th-percentile of 5-yr range — historically low.

news.geopolitics_summary: US Russia sanctions bill passed; EU-China trade tensions rising; Canada critical minerals partnership emerging amid energy independence push.

themes.headline: US House passes Russia sanctions bill, expanding leverage against Moscow
themes.why_it_matters: Escalating US-Russia sanctions risk further restrictions on Russian energy flows to EU. Tightens LNG arb window and supports TTF floor via reduced pipeline supply uncertainty.

themes.headline: Corpus Christi LNG Stage 3 completed; US becomes second-largest exporter globally
themes.why_it_matters: Increased US LNG export capacity adds 1.5–2 Bcf/d supply, improving arb competitiveness vs. TTF. Downward pressure on EU gas prices via LNG import diversion and TTF arbitrage compression.

themes.headline: US crude oil production forecast to hit record 13.8 million b/d in 2026
themes.why_it_matters: Record US crude supplies may moderate Brent, reducing fuel-oil and coal burn substitution risk in EU power generation. Indirect: lower crude softens thermal floor.

themes.headline: EU-China trade deficit hits tipping point; von der Leyen signals aggressive remedies
themes.why_it_matters: Potential EU tariffs on Chinese imports (including solar, wind, steel) could raise renewable capex costs and delay clean energy transition. Indirect pressure on long-term power decarbonisation timelines and cost curves.

themes.headline: EIB establishes Canada presence; critical minerals projects aim to diversify EU supply
themes.why_it_matters: Securing critical minerals (lithium, cobalt) from Canada backstops EU renewable energy and grid storage deployment. Long-term supply security underpins power transition capex and EUA valuation ceiling.

watchlist: US Russia sanctions implementation timeline; potential oil/gas flow restrictions.
Corpus Christi LNG ramp-up pace and first commercial shipment schedule.
EU trade remedies vs China (tariffs on solar/wind) — impact on renewable capex.
Von der Leyen climate/energy proposals follow-up; regulatory action expected Oct–Nov.
